body:
MY dad takes sonata for sleeping. I saw them and wanted to try them. I noticed they were in a capsule so I broke it opened and snorted the powder.I snorted the whole line and my nose did not hurt at all. It was so smooth. Then within a few seconds it was like my head was so happy and my body was so wiggly. But I could still talk and walk fine if I had to. It looked like the computer screen was stretching some small hallucinations. It lasted for about 20 minutes then I went to my bed and had an amazing sleep. Felt fine the next morning.
